independent_reproduction.script: alpha_agent.agents_v2.books.run_stage(stage='L') re-run by the skeptic on the same certified panel

search_denominator_charged.composition: 16 settled campaign cells under the same generation method (R56 V2's 7 + Wave 2's 9 halted cells) + 1 for the cell's own declared within-family multiplicity (within_family_tests = 2, charged as n-1) + 0 family prior (CROSS_ASSET_MOMENTUM had no prior settled test under this family key) + 0 generative prior (the pre-registration declares generative_search = false and CROSS_ASSET_MOMENTUM is not a machine-representation family); alpha_agent.r59.engines.gate then charges family_tests = 1 on top, giving 18.
search_denominator_charged.honest_reading: This is the best of ten Wave-2 draws, charged as such. A one-sided p of 0.0741 needs the denominator to be at most 1 to clear q = 0.10.

pit_integrity.method: POISON. Every finite ret in grid slots [t+1, end] replaced with noise, finiteness pattern preserved so no eligibility mask could move; the executor's own weights vector recomputed on all 44 lockbox decisions.
pit_integrity.evidence: max |dw| = 0.0 exactly, 44/44 decisions. Code facts: score reads _log_sum_return(ret, t-253, t-22) so the newest slot read is t-23; universe_all_traded counts OWN sessions in [t-252, t-1] and volume through t-2 (panels.py:150-190); the only t-dated read is live_markets = isfinite(ret[:, t]) (campaign_r56_v2/evaluator.py:78-85), a liveness flag known at the settlement of t, which IS the entry instant. layer['own'] == isfinite(ret) elementwise, so no forward fill (25.4% of grid slots are NaN); all 68 certified dated-contract markets retained, expired contracts included.

leakage_pass.method: TRUNCATION + POWER CONTROL. (1) Poison the SKIPPED most recent month, slots [t-22, t]. (2) Poison the window the signal claims to read, [t-253, t-22).
leakage_pass.evidence: (1) max |dw| = 0.0 on 44/44 lockbox decisions, so the 12-2 window genuinely excludes the last month. (2) weights moved on 44/44 decisions, min |dw| 0.0354, max 0.1455, so the zero in (1) is a real exclusion and not a dead test. Forward return is ret[:, t+1 : t+1+horizon] (campaign_r56_v2/evaluator.py:93), realised strictly after t from the settlement entry.

placebo_clean.method: ADOPTED FROM THE ENGINE AFTER INDEPENDENT REPRODUCTION. alpha_agent.r59.engines.placebo_verdict over alpha_agent.agents_v2.books.placebo_cost_neutral, 3 cross-sectional permutations, COST-NEUTRAL (R57 repair A4).
placebo_clean.evidence: Re-running the strongest placebo (seed 303) at the artifact's cost_mult 0.6223834940715799 reproduced ann_net_excess 0.014680076019452523 EXACTLY and cost drag 0.011782228152129034 = the candidate's to 1e-15. Margin 4.87%/yr against the frozen 1%/yr floor. Permutation fairness measured rather than assumed: permuted_score_fn shuffles finite entries across all 68 rows and the book zeroes anything landing on a non-live market, so the placebo could have carried less gross exposure; measured placebo mean_gross_notional 0.9716 / 0.9822 / 0.9738 vs the candidate's 1.0 - a worst-case 2.8% shortfall worth at most ~0.04pp on a 1.47%/yr placebo, immaterial to a 4.87pp margin.

cost_robust.method: lockbox re-run at 2x the pre-registered FUTURES_PER_MARKET_R38_PLUS_ROLL_V1 model
cost_robust.evidence: artifacts/H_973b93bc_61298a993f59.json lines 145-177: +5.16%/yr, t 1.177, drag 2.36%/yr against gross +7.52%/yr. Turnover 0.172 one-way is far inside the 0.40 ceiling. Cost is not what this book lives or dies on.

subperiod_stable.method: LEAVE-ONE-ECONOMIC-GROUP-OUT on the lockbox, added by the skeptic because the runner measured the TIME axis only and the frozen attack is 'not one subperiod, ONE INSTRUMENT or one event'. A group-level construction hides in the cross-section, not in the calendar.
subperiod_stable.evidence: Time axis PASSES: lockbox halves +7.59%/yr and +5.09%/yr, both positive. Cross-section axis FAILS: only 8 of 12 economic groups ever score (>= 3 members required), and removing SOFTS alone - 10 of 68 markets - collapses the lockbox from +6.34%/yr, t 1.446, to +1.01%/yr, t 0.199. One group of ten softs contracts produces 84% of the effect. Removing ENERGY instead IMPROVES it to +8.88%/yr, t 2.195, so the other seven groups do not carry a consistent cross-asset effect. The pre-registered claim is CROSS_ASSET; what was measured is a softs claim over a 2023-2026 lockbox - the same post-2022 softs regime that killed R56's basis-momentum cell.
subperiod_stable.note: The four groups with an unchanged number have fewer than 3 members and were never scorable.

not_a_duplicate_identity.threshold: |Spearman| >= 0.999 is a monotone re-expression (frozen; neither relaxed nor tightened)
not_a_duplicate_identity.method: Reconstructed the realised per-decision cross-sectional ordering on the IDENTICAL universe and decision grid (184 scored decisions across D/V/L) and rank-correlated it against three real neighbours. Rank correlation of realised WEIGHTS vs the score is 1.000, confirming a pure rank book, so the ordering IS the decision.
not_a_duplicate_identity.evidence: PASSES the frozen rule: no decision reaches 0.999 against any neighbour. But the number is reported, not rounded: algebraically f_i = group_mean + (group_mean - r_i)/(k-1), and the measurement confirms it - 94% of the ordering's rank information is plain complex-level 12-2 momentum, the leave-one-out step adds about 6%, and against the market's OWN momentum the correlation is only 0.40, so the construction is genuinely not own momentum. It is group momentum with a small within-group reversal tilt.

review.kill_reason: CONCENTRATION: one of the eight scoring economic groups produces 84% of the lockbox. Leave-one-group-out on SOFTS (10 of 68 markets) takes the lockbox from +6.34%/yr, t 1.446, to +1.01%/yr, t 0.199, so the pre-registered CROSS_ASSET claim is not supported by the cross-section that was traded.
review.no_rescue: This verdict is final. The candidate is not re-runnable with a narrowed universe, a different sign, a softer cost or a longer sample. A SOFTS-only book is not adoptable as a by-product of this test; it would need a fresh human-authorised pre-registration on untouched data.

multiple_testing_exposure.statement: One candidate of ten reached a lockbox and it is the maximum of that draw. Its unadjusted lockbox p of 0.0741 is exactly the kind of number a best-of-ten selection produces by chance; corrected for the 18 charged tests it is 1.0. The director should discount it accordingly.
